verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a dedicated Jupyter connection guide and an instance portal that creates Cloudflare tunnels for open ports, so browser-based Jupyter access is supported. IDE connection is only implied through key-based SSH access, with no evidence of a VS Code or Cursor integration or a true one-step flow. Missing for 10: documented one-click Jupyter launch flow, explicit VS Code/Cursor remote connection support, independent hands-on corroboration.
